items.text: Raymond James reported trailing 12-month production of $538 million for recruited advisors coming into its domestic independent contractor and employee channels during fiscal 2026.
items.quote: Raymond James reported trailing 12-month production of $538 million for recruited advisors coming into its domestic independent contractor and employee channels during the fiscal year, up from $407 million from the prior year.
items.scope: domestic independent contractor and employee channels

items.text: Raymond James reported trailing 12-month production of $407 million for recruited advisors in the prior fiscal year, against which the $538 million was compared.
items.quote: up from $407 million from the prior year
items.scope: domestic independent contractor and employee channels

items.text: In fiscal 2025 the firm recruited production advisors with prior production of over $400 million, up 21% over last year's record.
items.quote: in fiscal 2025, we recruited production advisors with prior production of over $400 million, which was up 21% over last year's record.

items.text: For fiscal 2024, the firm recruited financial advisors with approximately $335 million of trailing 12-month production at their previous firms.
items.quote: For the fiscal year, we recruited financial advisors with approximately $335 million of trailing 12-month production and $56.7 billion of client assets at their previous firms.

items.text: For fiscal 2024, the firm recruited financial advisors with $56.7 billion of client assets at their previous firms.
items.quote: $56.7 billion of client assets at their previous firms

items.text: The firm's 7% annualized net new assets for the first half of its fiscal year is leading, or at least a leader in, the industry, driven by both recruiting and retention.
items.quote: that's really what's driven the 7% annualized net new assets for the first half of our fiscal year, which is leading the industry and at least a leader in the industry as far as net new assets go, and that's both from recruiting but also retention

items.text: The firm reports a 97% advisor satisfaction rate, which the CEO says is the best he knows of in the industry.
items.quote: we have 97% adviser satisfaction rate, 97% adviser satisfaction rate with our surveys, which is the best I know of in the industry when I speak to other CEOs and other firms.

items.text: The firm has the largest addressable market in the industry because it offers all the affiliation options an advisor could want.
items.quote: we have the largest addressable market in the industry because we have all the affiliation options that an adviser could possibly want.

items.text: An analyst noted that some peers have seen a slowdown in recruitment and cited deteriorating returns on advisor or asset recruitment given elevated transition assistance rates.
items.quote: Admittedly, some of your peers, which have seen a slowdown in recruitment have cited deteriorating returns on adviser or asset recruitment just given elevated TA rates.

items.text: The firm says its recruiting has never been stronger, with activity in fiscal 2025 and entering fiscal 2026 extremely robust and showing no signs of slowing.
items.quote: The recruiting has never been stronger. The recruiting activity, both in the fiscal 2025 and as we enter into 2026, is extremely robust and showing no real signs of slowing down.

items.text: Long-tenured teams at the firm say it has not seen this type of acceleration in recruiting activity since the financial crisis, and that the advisors now being recruited are much larger.
items.quote: we really have not seen this type of acceleration in activity since the financial crisis. Of course, the advisors that we are talking to now are much larger than the advisors that were talking to us after the financial crisis

items.text: The firm contrasts its approach with competitors that it says increasingly seek an exit in three to five years and compete with the largest check, while Raymond James attracts advisors with culture, service and platform.
items.quote: so many of our competitors are increasingly looking for an exit in three to five years or even less... many of our competitors compete with the largest check. We value independence

items.text: The Ohio hire extends a consistent run of Raymond James & Associates recruiting from UBS throughout 2026, as advisors at the wirehouse respond to changes in compensation.
items.quote: The Ohio hire extends a consistent run of Raymond James & Associates recruiting from UBS throughout 2026 , as advisors at the wirehouse continue to respond to changes in how the firm compensates its advisor workforce.

items.text: Raymond James recruited a team previously managing more than $550 million in client assets at UBS Financial Services.
items.quote: the team previously managed more than $550 million in client assets at UBS Financial Services.

items.text: Raymond James has been building out advisor headcount across multiple channels in 2026, drawing recruits from wirehouses and regional firms alike.
items.quote: Raymond James has been building out its advisor headcount across multiple channels in 2026, drawing recruits from wirehouses and regional firms alike.

items.text: Earlier in 2026 the firm brought on breakaway teams from Wells Fargo and Morgan Stanley whose combined assets exceeded $1 billion.
items.quote: the firm brought on breakaway teams from Wells Fargo and Morgan Stanley whose combined assets exceeded $1 billion
